family: The single total charged-prefix language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. Finite failed lengths use the fixed legacy evaluator. At all sufficiently large actual lengths N, L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L), and k is the least power of two at least L^28*z^10. The payload uses the supplied deterministic-tower linear condenser, streamed affine extractors, refreshed affine index/look-ahead construction and robust almost-independent-bit function in disperser.md A1,B1-B7. Initial extraction keeps dimension10000 for polynomial seed enumeration; the five internal extractor dimensions equal z. Every construction datum is an actual prefix bit; the entire prefix has P=O(L^15*z^6). Large condenser extension fields are computed deterministically. Invalid prefixes still give total bounded ring/matrix evaluation. The payload is zero-padded injectively; no witness, advice, or oracle supplies fields.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence NP with empty witnesses. Unconditionally in the pinned full B2 model, for every sufficiently large integer actual length N, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-32*(log2 N)^28*(log2(log2 N))^10. The exact eventual loss is R(N)=4*P(N)+8*k(N), with k the least power of two at least ceil(log2 N)^28*ceil(log2(ceil(log2 N)))^10 and P=O(ceil(log2 N)^15*ceil(log2(ceil(log2 N)))^6); every prefix bit is charged. For this SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^(28+epsilon), and hence also C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-N^epsilon. The supplied proofs establish all-length affine dispersal at dimension k, the full-B2 finite bound4n-8d, uniform polynomial-time evaluation and exact actual input accounting.
